style.styleTitle: Personalised Couples Cut Out Wooden Names and Date Christmas Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: A personalised Christmas bauble, perfect for any newly married couple. The glass bauble surrounds an intricately laser cut wooden layer featuring the couples titles (i.e. Mr & Mrs) followed by the surname and the wedding date surrounded by small floral and foliage details, all laser cut from wood. Please select the titles from the drop down and enter the surname and date into the field provided. The bauble measures approximately 10 x 10 cm.
